They operate a website with Menu, Locations, a dedicated B2B/Corporate page, Feedbacks, and Recruitment sections, plus social presence on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn, and a food-ordering app (Gwee Barra Ltd food ordering app on Play Store). Orders come via phone, Instagram, WhatsApp, and delivery aggregators like foodpanda. Custom cake orders — the highest-margin product — are handled manually with no online custom-order form.

pricing_knowledge.note: Custom wedding cakes are the highest-margin, most enquiry-intensive product — each requires design, tiers, date, and delivery coordination. An AI agent that captures custom-cake specs over WhatsApp and confirms pricing instantly is the highest-leverage automation, especially in peak wedding season.

business_profile.competitive_position: Cooper's competes with other Dhaka bakeries for custom wedding cakes and corporate orders. Their edge is an established brand and a real web/app presence. But custom-cake intake is manual, and in peak wedding season every missed or slow-handled enquiry goes to a competitor. An AI custom-order agent would make them the most responsive bakery for high-margin cakes.
business_profile.opportunity_size: Custom wedding cakes command premium prices and peak-season demand spikes ~150%. If manual intake loses even a fraction of custom-cake enquiries during wedding season — plus corporate orders that aren't captured automatically — that's substantial lost high-margin revenue. An AI order agent recovers this and smooths peak-season capacity.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI custom-cake agent that captures design, tiers, servings, and delivery date over WhatsApp and confirms pricing instantly.
2. Order-status agent that sends updates and eliminates inbound status calls.
3. B2B/corporate intake agent that handles bulk order quotes.
4. Peak-season management agent that tracks order capacity and prevents overbooking.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A bride messages Cooper's on Instagram at 9pm: 'I need a 3-tier wedding cake for December 12, white with gold accents.' The AI replies instantly: 'Beautiful! For a 3-tier cake serving ~150, our custom wedding cakes start at ৳X. December 12 is available — want me to book a tasting and hold the date?' The bride books; Cooper's captured a high-margin custom order overnight with zero staff effort.
